entities.summary: Maxim Vladimirovich Mamin is a Russian professional ice hockey forward currently playing for the HC Dynamo Moscow in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted 175th overall in the 2016 NHL Entry Draft by the Florida Panthers.
